native_image_rule: Never upscale or resample a smaller generated image to claim native resolution. If source image tool cannot natively meet the exact requested pixel dimensions, record blocker; do not fake pixels.
commit_scope: Only destinations listed in each job, plus this queue file's per-entry state (if updated), with GitHub permissions; do not replace any previously existing image.
item_order: Array order: legacy tile and screen reference collection first, building new material photos next. Process ONE job at a time.
